title: Application MailRelay Postfix Entity
description: Postfix-specific configuration. Extends Application/MailRelay with postfix-specific settings.

myhostname.description: The hostname of this mail system.

mydomain.description: The domain name of this mail system.

mynetworks.description: Trusted networks allowed to relay through this server.

inet_interfaces.description: Network interfaces to listen on (loopback-only or all).

smtp_tls_security_level.description: TLS security level for outbound SMTP connections.

alias_maps.description: Mail alias mappings (key: alias, value: destination).
